Both Pilosanol B and Voxtalisib are known to interact with Betaine--homocysteine S-methyltransferase 1, indicating a possible pathway through which the compound may influence the enzyme. The evidence suggests that the compound may act as a modulator or inhibitor of the enzyme, potentially through interactions with its downstream targets.
